note: One-shot (ADR-14): waits for the cluster to be yellow with the elastic credential, then creates the role grdm_osf (cluster monitor; every privilege on website* and private__website* only) and the user grdm_osf with ELASTIC8_OSF_PASSWORD, through idempotent PUTs, so it runs at every `up` and exits 0 quickly. osf.io searches with that user, never with the superuser. The image's grdm-entrypoint.sh runs any command that is not elasticsearch itself unchanged, so this service needs no config tmpfs. The credentials reach curl through its config on stdin, not the command line. It waits for elasticsearch8 to be healthy (the TLS port answers) and then for a yellow cluster.
